reviews.text: Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Good

I have a large  pit bull  who is VERY strong and VERY hyperactive. These young men were SO calm and relaxed from drop off to pick up. I can not say enough good things about my experience. My dog has anxiety but they handled him with care relaxation and a positive energy that lit up my day with sunshine. Best experience ever!
Fantastic experience for our fur baby Chloe Rose, Ruby was friendly kind and patient Ruby did a great job of clipping Chloe’s nails Great service Thankyou
Luna came out fresh and clean! Her groomer was great!
We have been bringing our puppy to be groomed by Matthew. He is the best groomer we have had.

Came to get my dog groomed. She arrived with no fleas and came home with them. It was a nightmare. Staff including manager of grooming service Matt was very nonchalant and dismissive of the issue. Will not be back or recommend.
Made an appointment in store. They were on time and called me when she was ready. Everything went very smoothly.
The people at PetCo Grooming on LaBrea are so thoughtful and kind and do a wonderful job!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

First time taking Poncho for a groom at the LaBrea Petco. Rick did a fantastic job! He was personable and really took the time to ask questions and get to know Poncho. When I picked Poncho up, not only was I impressed with the detailed grooming, I was also impressed that Poncho was not stressed. I will be definitely be bringing Poncho back to Rick at Petco.

Brought my pup 'Blake' in for grooming. Rick did a super job with Blake's summer cut! The other team members at the front desk were also very helpful at check-in and check-out. Great experience all around! -Paul
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

Great job!-
Suzy treats Chanel like a Princess !
I love the added touches ‘
Great price friendly service  and great groomers !❤️❤️❤️❤️😍

Matthew did a fantastic job as usual, washing. Grooming, nails, etc with my little 14 year old Shih Tzu mix. I will return and request Matthew, and I hope he stays at Petco. My Charlie looks as cute as can be!

We usually have a great experience at this Petco but Ruby, who might be new at this location(?) was super helpful with our boy Brody. The last time we took him in, although his groomer was nice, trimmed his nails a little too short which caused them to start bleeding after going for a walk. We had mentioned this to Ruby and she was very mindful of every details we’ve shared with her about Brody. When he was finished, he looked super refreshed and handsome :)

Tristan, our groomer, provided exemplary care to our dog, Kona and ourselves. His attention to detail was much appreciated and his attentiveness to the needs of our dog was incredibly appreciative. I would highly recommend him for  future grooming needs.

This was my first time coming to get my two dogs groomed and I had a nice first time experience, Ruby was kind and gentle and very friendly towards my dogs .. she explained everything well and I felt confident they were in great hands , their nail trim was just how I wanted and overall Ruby did a fantastic job

Over 6 1/2 hours for a hair cut and still not done when i tried to pick her up  the whole hair cut was not done correctly her whole face was uneven and in the body as well . Never coming back
Do not waste your time. I had to take her somewhere else to have her to fix her haircut. Also close to 7 hours for a puppy to not drink water or eat or going poop is absurd. I wouldn’t even give a 1 start if I could .
Awesome service . Highly recommended
We're sorry to hear that your recent experience resulted in a less-than-positive rating. Your feedback is important to us.

I am very unhappy with my pets haircut. They did not follow haircut instructions. They barely took any fur off my dog, my pet looks basically the same as when I dropped her off just more fluffy. And the spots that they did trim are uneven and choppy.
Suzy was awesome with our boy , very gentle and really knew how to take care of him.

On the search for a grooming place that I can trust for my mini goldendoodle & I came across this location! I decided to give it a shot and book an appointment with Matthew because of the other reviews here. Matthew was really nice and had a calm nice demeanor which made me feel comfortable right away! He asked me what kind of cut I was looking to do for my dog and then asked if there’s anything that he should be aware of & took a look at his body. I really liked that because you can tell he cares about the details. He called me after 2.5-3 hours & when I picked up my dog - he was perfect! The cut was what I wanted & he did a really great job on the sanitary areas. Overall, I’m really happy with the experience & results! Thank you!

Karen was very kind and patient throughout the visit with my pups - SHE was the ONLY one in that grooming store that was nice. SHE needs a promotion ⭐️⭐️⭐️

Butttt .. I'm not sure who the other dude was but he wasn't very nice. Needs more training and be more humble. @petco please train your gen staff to be more friendly.
Great price, care about my dog, professional and friendly staff!
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We value your feedback and apologize if we didn’t meet your expectations.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Raquel O. was amazing with my pup!  We did the mini make rover and she was able to complete it all even on my wiggly puppy. Super helpful and kind. Will definitely be coming back.

I didn't realize my dog was being difficult during her previous appointments, I wasn't made aware. The staff still allowed me to make an appointment for Piper, despite being on the naughty list and were patient with her. I am grateful for their tolerance and patience with my scared little girl.
the best for me and my dog

Matthew was great. My dog Muddy looked beautiful and had a much needed Grooming session. I wish I had extra funds to tip him. I used to take my previous Husky to this Petco and they were always nice and treated my dogs well.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Very nice and great job on grooming

Had a really frustrating experience today with a stylist named Rick. I’ve been bringing my dogs to Petco for grooming for almost 2 years, but this might be the last time.

I came in for a regular wash, cut, and deshedding, but Rick immediately started lecturing me about how my dog doesn’t like kennels and said I should’ve booked a VIP service — which I didn’t even know existed. He then started reading notes from the system and seemed to realize my dog might be a little difficult during haircuts.

Next, he started looking in my dog’s ears and said there might be an infection, just because my dog didn’t want him touching them. The ears looked fine to me, but he still said I needed a vet’s approval before coming back.

Honestly, it felt like he just didn’t want to do the grooming and was trying to find a reason not to. Disappointing and unprofessional.

Edit regarding a response: I took my dog to PetSmart for grooming and they said there was no issues with his ears… (:
I had two dogs groomed at the same time. Both were well taken care of and look FANTASTIC. Great job team!
I got a great haircut and bath. Well my dog did.

I arrived an hour earlier than their estimated 3–4-hour timeframe and found they had just finished showering my dog. It makes me wonder what the first two hours were used for—was my dog crated and made to wait? It seems unnecessary. On top of that, they didn’t follow any of my styling requests, the upgraded shampoo has an overpowering scent, and my pup came back scratching a lot. I chose this store because of the great reviews, but my experience was disappointing.

This is a Shout out for TATIANA in grooming!  She not only does an incredible job in my two Miniature Schnauzer puppies. I recently had a horrible experience at another local grooming place. Seeing how excited my boys were to see her, how feeling how much love and passion she has for her work and the digs was special. I will, from now on, only have my boys groomed by Tatiana.

I am very pleased with this location. Tatiana was very nice and friendly when I came into the location. She made Dulce and me feel comfortable . Viviana  also gave us the same friendliness and was really attentive to Dulce. She made sure to fulfill my expectations on the cut I wanted. She did a wonderful job with Dulce. She went above and beyond with lots of attention to detail. Dulce seemed calm and happy after the cut. I hope to keep getting these great service and experiences.

Tatiana is absolutely amazing! She has been my groomer for about a year, and I can honestly say she does a fantastic job every single time. My shorkie is very nervous when it comes to grooming, but Tatiana is always so patient and makes my baby feel comfortable every visit.

Thank you so much!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The Best Groomer for Our Baby Girl Akila!

Tatiana is truly exceptional! From the moment we met her, it was clear how much she genuinely cares about her clients and their furry family members. She takes the time to communicate and listen to Akila’s specific needs, ensuring every detail is handled with care.

Our Akila can be a little particular, but Tatiana’s patience and gentle approach put her completely at ease. She always comes home looking amazing and, most importantly, happy! It’s such a relief to have a groomer who is not only talented but also attentive and compassionate.

Thank you, Tatiana, for going above and beyond every time! We couldn’t imagine trusting anyone else with our baby girl.
Thank you for the positive review, Arrick Nixon! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us.
Hi Aura Darinka Sandoval. We're thrilled to see that you gave us a high-paw rating! Your support means a lot to us, and we're glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Tatianna was incredible and made sure to listen to my every grooming request when it came to my puppy Coal. She went over pricing and made sure I was comfortable with every detail. I’m so happy with his haircut and will definitely be back in the future!
Thank you for the positive review, Nachum Benyosef! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us.
Our favorite Petco location, separate grooming entrance, super friendly and thorough staff.
I like how they treat my dog ​​when I take him there, and the staff are very kind and caring towards animals.
Everyone here provides excellent service, but I especially like how Tatiana takes care of Bizcocho 💜 he always comes out looking so fresh and pampered! …

SO BLESSED for the team here! Recently moved and always been a huge fan for Petco grooming! Our first visit was awesome! The staff are so kind and friendly. Philly had a great time there. Will keep coming to this location now. Excellent service and skills!
